tokens.gaps: 11 small monthly ecosystem/foundation steps (~3.69M ALLO, ~1.5-1.8% of circulating) on the 11th from 11 Dec 2025 to 11 Oct 2026 (inclusive window end). Only Aug 2026 is confirmed by news (KuCoin, 00:00 UTC). Apr-Oct are shown by tokenomics.com, and Dec-Mar are inferred from its event count, the primary two-year linear terms and CoinLaunch. Main gap: the exact size. 3.69M is the primary-derived figure, but the Tokenomist USD value for Aug implies ~4.7M, so trackers may fold in emissions or staking rewards. The first insider unlock (Backers 102.47M + Core Contributors 57.75M) is 11 Nov 2026, outside the window.

verify.notes: The Allora blog gives Foundation 44.25M and Ecosystem 44.25M vesting linearly over 24 months, which is 1.84M + 1.84M = 3.69M a month. CoinLaunch says linear vesting started 11 Dec 2025 and shows 20.28M released per pool (11 steps). CoinGabbar, which the researcher did not cite, independently confirms 3.69M split 1.84M/1.84M on 11 Aug 2026. tokenomics.com lists the 11 Apr to 11 Oct 2026 rows.

dropped.why: The 92.8M figure (52.8M Early Backers + 40M Core Contributors) comes from pre-repurchase docs. Capricorn bought back 5.3% (~52.8M) from early investors in Aug 2026 with undisclosed new vesting; tokenomics.com now shows Early Backers at 10.7% (cliff ~35.3M), CryptoLinks says the Oct treatment is unconfirmed, and published estimates run from ~70.9M to ~149.7M. No post-event source confirms what actually transferred on 23 Oct.

The only evidence is one Phoenix Group infographic, carried by MEXC and BlockchainReporter. tokenomics.com puts every COCA allocation behind a cliff of 24 months or more from the 1 Dec 2024 TGE, with the first post-TGE unlock on 1 Dec 2026. Its 11.3% unlocked figure equals the TGE amount (13.5M treasury + 100M liquidity), which leaves no room for an 18.38M release in Dec 2025.

The only source is a USD-only tracker mention of an Aug 1 event. Tokenomist (kite-2) and CoinLaunch both put KITE releases on the 3rd of the month (next 3 Nov 2026, 153.33M per CoinLaunch) and list nothing for Aug 1. Date, amount and type are unsupported.

No source gives a token amount. Tokenomist places events on a 30-day grid (11 Feb 2026, then 8 Nov 2026, exactly 270 days later), while tokenomics.com schedules investors and insiders monthly on the 14th (12-month cliff plus 24-month linear). This looks like a tracker-modelled step, not a confirmed transfer, and could not be fixed.
